title: Boost/MAP Sensor Low
shortDescription: Boost or MAP sensor signal below threshold.
fullDescription: Volvo Penta EVC ECU reads boost pressure sensor below limit. Common on D4/D6 diesel engines.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat boost sensor connector on intake manifold.

faq.a: Yes, EVC reduces power but allows safe operation.

title: Coolant Temperature Low Input
fullDescription: EVC ECU reads coolant sensor too low. Default cold-start fueling applied.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Check ECT connector for water intrusion.

faq.a: Yes, low ECT prevents regen on emissions diesels.

title: Turbocharger Overboost
fullDescription: Volvo Penta diesel turbo overboost. Wastegate or VGT control fault.

fixSteps.title: Inspect actuator
fixSteps.instruction: Check wastegate or VGT actuator linkage.

fixSteps.title: Service turbo
fixSteps.instruction: Free or replace wastegate or turbo as needed.

whenToCallPro: Turbo work requires marine diesel specialist.

faq.a: Yes EVC limits power to protect engine.

title: Turbocharger Underboost
fullDescription: Volvo Penta diesel making less boost than expected. Boost leak or turbo wear.

fixSteps.title: Inspect intercooler hoses
fixSteps.instruction: Check clamps and rubber boots for leaks.

faq.a: Hose repair yes; turbo work no.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: EVC cannot synchronize without CKP. No-start condition.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Check CKP for damage and metal debris.

faq.a: Yes a typical no-start cause on EVC engines.

title: EVC Communication Lost
shortDescription: Helm or display lost EVC bus communication.
fullDescription: Volvo Penta EVC bus communication interrupted. Multifunction display may go blank.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect/reconnect EVC junctions at engine and helm.

fixSteps.title: Verify terminators
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm bus terminators on both ends.

faq.a: Limited; head back at low RPM if no engine data is shown.

title: Sea Water Temperature High
fullDescription: Sea water inlet temperature high. May indicate flow restriction or warm-water operation.

title: DPF Efficiency Below Threshold
shortDescription: Diesel particulate filter not regenerating properly.
fullDescription: Tier 3/4 Volvo Penta diesels with DPF report low efficiency. Soot accumulation high.

fixSteps.title: Manual regen
fixSteps.instruction: Run extended high-load cruise to trigger regen.

fixSteps.title: Replace dp sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new DPF differential pressure sensor.

fixSteps.title: DPF service
fixSteps.instruction: Have DPF cleaned or replaced by Volvo dealer.

faq.a: Will eventually trigger derate; do regen runs proactively.

title: Barometric Pressure Sensor Range
shortDescription: Internal baro sensor signal out of plausible range.
fullDescription: EVC internal baro sensor failure. Affects boost compensation.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECU
fixSteps.instruction: Replace EVC ECU if internal sensor failed.

title: Main Relay Power Hold Fault
shortDescription: ECU main relay does not hold power after key off.
fullDescription: EVC main relay control fault. ECU cannot complete shutdown sequence.

fixSteps.title: Inspect relay
fixSteps.instruction: Locate main relay in engine bay; swap with similar.

fixSteps.title: Test relay control
fixSteps.instruction: Verify control voltage during key-off period.

faq.a: Yes if you suspect parasitic drain while diagnosing.
